abstract: Audits convoy travel distances and route odometer baselines
system_message:
You are the Fleet navigation supervisor (NAV), responsible for auditing convoy travel distances and route odometer baselines across candidate transit options.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Audits convoy travel distances and route odometer baselines（DIST）
information_points.content:
NAV-DIST-JYX：Within the Simulation testing environment, the total route distance recorded for the Northern Valley Alpine Corridor is 160 km.
NAV-DIST-6UV：Within the Production GIS environment, the Southern Gorge Freight Arterial covers a total route distance of 110 km between the staging depot and the high-altitude field hospital.
NAV-DIST-ERE：Under the Production GIS environment, the total route distance for the Northern Valley Alpine Corridor from the valley staging depot to the high-altitude field hospital is 140 km.
NAV-DIST-HB7：According to the Production GIS environment, the Pinnacle Pass Highline Bypass measures a total route distance of 110 km from the valley staging depot to the field hospital.

information_points.title: Convoy speed management（SPEED）
information_points.content:
NAV-SPEED-F1E：The safe average convoy speed along the Pinnacle Pass Highline Bypass is rated at 35 km/h for loaded transport vehicles under packed-snow conditions.
NAV-SPEED-ZCR：For the Northern Valley Alpine Corridor, the safe average convoy speed for loaded tractor-trailer heavy transport sections under packed-snow conditions is 45 km/h.
NAV-SPEED-VOE：Fleet telemetry assessments determine a safe average convoy speed of 55 km/h for loaded tractor-trailer transports on the Southern Gorge Freight Arterial under packed snow.
